tasks.label: dapr:web_vms:start
args: pid_dir=/tmp/web_vms-dapr; name=web_vms; pid_file="$pid_dir/$name.pid"; log_file="$pid_dir/$name.log"; daprd_bin="$(command -v daprd || true)"; if [ -z "$daprd_bin" ] && [ -x "$HOME/.dapr/bin/daprd" ]; then daprd_bin="$HOME/.dapr/bin/daprd"; fi; mkdir -p "$pid_dir"; if [ -f "$pid_file" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$pid_file")" 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; rm -f "$pid_file"; if [ -z "$daprd_bin" ]; then echo "daprd not found in PATH or \$HOME/.dapr/bin" > "$log_file"; exit 1; fi; nohup "$daprd_bin" -app-id web-vms -app-port 5134 -app-protocol http -dapr-http-port 3500 -dapr-grpc-port 50001 -metrics-port 9090 > "$log_file" 2>&1 & echo $! > "$pid_file"; sleep 2; if ! kill -0 "$(cat "$pid_file")" 2>/dev/null; then echo "daprd for $name failed to stay running. Log:"; sed -n '1,120p' "$log_file"; exit 1; fi

tasks.label: dapr:web_vms:stop
args: if [ -f /tmp/web_vms-dapr/web_vms.pid ]; then kill "$(cat /tmp/web_vms-dapr/web_vms.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f /tmp/web_vms-dapr/web_vms.pid; fi
